neighbours.label: the second member of a paired 'X and Y' coordination of nouns or adjectives ('industry and government', 'Mother and baby', 'producer and consumer')
fire: Both teacher and student must sign the form before the trip.
The report looks at supply and demand in the housing market.
Buyer and seller agreed on a price after two meetings.
The clinic serves rural and urban families across the state.
Employer and employee both pay into the pension fund.
The study compared male and female birds during migration.
Parent and child classes run every Saturday morning.
The museum covers ancient and modern art in two wings.
quiet: The student must sign the form before the trip, they said.
The report looks at demand in the housing market this year.
The seller agreed on a price after two meetings with us.
The clinic serves families across the whole state.
The employee pays into the pension fund every month.
The study followed female birds during their migration.
Classes for each child run every Saturday morning.
The museum covers modern art in its two large wings.

notes: Card: industry and government, Production and Perception, Mother and baby, producer and consumer countries, individual and collective. Near misses use the same nouns outside a pair.
